The '''Uncanny Rotstem''' was a type of plant native to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It had large green leaves that turned orange near the tip. These plants were a common sight around the planets capital of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onderonian Botanist" />
